name: Power Gem
notes: Power Gem: more damage for all the player's moves at each of its 5 levels: +2%, +1%, +2%, +1%, +2% (+8% in all; 1.5% a level, taking turns since there are no half percents). Adds that to boost_power (the floor Power Gem adds 5 to the same boost). Offered on the waves mode's level-up menu (menu_power); its level is kept in 'up_power' (back to 0 each run).
title: POWER GEM
